thread:
Maria: quick sync — want to run a short pattern review for incidents in the last 90 days. I grouped them into themes and sketched proposed owners + timelines. ping if you want to join.

Patchbot: Incident ingest complete — 27 incidents found in 90d. Clustering produced 6 groups (resource-exhaustion, config-drift, cold-start regressions, 3rd-party auth flakiness, canary rollout misses, infra-deploy failures). Report: https://inhouse/reports/incident-cluster-90d

Ben: SG. can you drop the short summary here? I can take config-drift and runbook follow-ups.

Maria: summary pasted below: 
- Resource exhaustion: 9 incidents, common at peak traffic around model refresh windows.
- Config drift (autoscaler, pool tags): 6 incidents, often after infra changes.
- Cold-start regressions: 5 incidents, tail-latency spikes after model swaps.
- 3p auth flakiness: 4 incidents, external token refresh failures + no circuit breaker.
- Canary misses: 2 incidents, slow rollout detection.

Alex: I can own resource-exhaustion fixes. Proposal: adjust autoscaler policies + add proactive capacity margin for model refresh windows.

Sara: I will take cold-start caching & warmup runbooks. estimate: 2 sprints.

Priya: I'll take auth retries + circuit breaker. Need product sign-off for retry budget. @Nina can you weigh in?

Nina: product ok with circuit breaker, but want telemetry to show user impact reduction before greenlight.

Ben: for config-drift I want to add automated drift-detection + a pre-merge linter for pool tags. ETA: 2026-04-01. Need eng-infra help. @Alex fyi. :thumbsup:

Maria: Proposed action items (I'll open follow-up tickets and link here):
```
- ACTION-1: Autoscaler policy revision. Owner: Alex. ETA: 2026-04-15. Deliverables: new policy, load test runbook, alerting.
- ACTION-2: Config drift detection + linter. Owner: Ben. ETA: 2026-04-01. Deliverables: linter, periodic diff job, postmortem checklist.
- ACTION-3: Cold-start warmup & caching. Owner: Sara. ETA: 2026-05-01. Deliverables: warmup lib, benchmark, rollout plan.
- ACTION-4: Auth retries & circuit breaker. Owner: Priya. ETA: 2026-03-31. Deliverables: retry middleware, metrics, product sign-off.
- ACTION-5: Canary rollout monitor improvements. Owner: Maria. ETA: 2026-04-10. Deliverables: success criteria, automated rollback thresholds.
```

Alex: adding alert suggestion for resource exhaustion:
```
expr: rate(machine_cpu_seconds_total{job=\"runtime\"}[5m]) > 0.85 and sum by(cluster)(node_capacity_cpu) - sum by(cluster)(node_allocated_cpu) < 2
for: 10m
labels: severity=page
annotations: summary=\"possible pool exhaustion during spike\"
```

Ben: I'll coordinate with eng-infra for the linter. Assign me to ACTION-2 and add eng-infra as reviewer.

Priya: I need a quick risk assessment for retry budget (impact on downstream 3p). tagging @Nina to approve testing window.

Nina: approve a 48-hour low-traffic window for integration tests.

Maria: I'll create follow-up tickets: ENG-XXXX (autoscaler), ENG-YYYY (config drift), ENG-ZZZZ (cold-start), ENG-AAAA (auth). Will update this thread with ticket links once created.

Patchbot: Reminder — ACTION items without owner after 48h will escalate to oncall.

Sara: :eyes: starting a small benchmark today, will post perf numbers in this thread.

Alex: :thumbsup: will draft the autoscaler policy and share a diff by next Tue.

Ben: Confirming owners: Alex (ACTION-1), Ben (ACTION-2), Sara (ACTION-3), Priya (ACTION-4), Maria (ACTION-5). If anyone needs to swap, call it out by EOD.

Priya: small ask — can we add a short QA checklist to ACTION-4 for rollback triggers? I'll add to the ticket.

Maria: great. I'll schedule a 30m sync next Tue to review drafts and blockers. Calendar invite coming. Thanks all. :rocket:
